subject.title: Feature Request: Plugin Circuit Breaker for graceful degradation

question: What plugin circuit-breaker contract should core expose before implementation?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses plugin API semantics, hook execution order, persisted runtime state, operator controls, and degradation policy, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract.

options.title: Design the core breaker contract first
options.body: Specify the generic plugin-host API, telemetry, SQLite state, status/reset commands, and rollout mode before implementation.

options.title: Keep breakers plugin-local
options.body: Close or narrow this request and let owner plugins implement their own degradation using existing hook timeouts and plugin-local state.

options.title: Ship passive telemetry first
options.body: Start with non-enforcing hook attribution and breaker diagnostics, then decide later whether core should skip unhealthy hooks.

recommendation.title: Design the core breaker contract first
recommendation.body: Specify the generic plugin-host API, telemetry, SQLite state, status/reset commands, and rollout mode before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook runner and plugin runtime history makes this the strongest available owner for the core plugin-host contract decision.
